description: This file defines a static enum GatewayDiscoverySelectionSupport containing functions to determine and apply remote gateway selection logic based on gateway properties and current application state, primarily used in gateway discovery and configuration management.

methods.name: applyRemoteSelection
methods.description: Updates the application state with the preferred remote gateway and transport details based on discovery info.

methods.name: preferredTransport
methods.description: Determines the preferred transport method for a given gateway, defaulting to current unless direct is preferred.

methods.name: shouldPreferDirectTransport
methods.description: Evaluates whether the gateway should be accessed directly based on its URL and hostname patterns.
